run_preprocess_eval_files: run the python module to extract Human3.6M dataset files needed for evaluation with protocol 1 and 2
run_preprocess_train_files: run the python module to extract MPI-INF-3DHP, LSP, LSP-Extended, MPII, and COCO training dataset files
extract_h36m_dataset: extract the Human3.6M dataset using h36m_extract with protocol 1 and image extraction enabled
extract_mpi_inf_3dhp: extract the MPI-INF-3DHP dataset using mpi_inf_3dhp_extract for training with static fits and image extraction
extract_coco_dataset: extract the COCO dataset using coco_extract with the configured COCO root and openpose paths
